title: Install a .deb package file
summary: Use dpkg to install a downloaded .deb package file. This is useful when you have a specific package file and want to install it manually.

steps.explain: Install the specified .deb package file using dpkg. You need administrator rights to install software.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the .deb package file you want to install

rollback.explain: Remove the package if you need to undo the installation.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the package to remove

warnings: Installing .deb files manually bypasses dependency resolution. If the package has missing dependencies, you may need to install them separately or use apt instead.
